Since you already have a team lunch scheduled for Thursday, aim for baked goods you can prep the night before or that are quick to finish afterward. Good options for a small colleague gathering are:
• Savory bite‑size muffins or cheese scones – easy to make ahead and serve at room temperature.
• Mini quiches or frittata cups – bite‑sized, satisfying, and can be reheated quickly.
• Classic cookies (e.g., chocolate chip or oatmeal raisin) – bake a batch the day before; they stay fresh.
• Brownies or blondies – simple, crowd‑pleasing, and can be cut into small squares.
• A simple fruit tart or lemon bars – fresh, light, and easy to portion.
Pick one or two that fit the time you have before or after the lunch, and you’ll have a hassle‑free spread for your colleagues.
